purpose: Decorative flat illustrations behind the main bento activity card of each event brief. These are generated illustrations, not photographs of the events.

images.prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual.
Asset type: decorative background image for the large activity card in an existing bento-box conference slide.
Primary request: sophisticated flat editorial illustration about learning with AI, designed as a quiet bento-box background. Landscape 3:2 canvas. Crisp flat filled shapes, restrained rounded geometry, clean edges, minimal linework, no 3D, no photography, no gradients, no grain.
Composition: a compact but detailed illustrated vignette occupies the central horizontal band, especially the middle-right of the canvas, from 20% to 50% height. The top 17% and bottom 45% MUST be completely empty uniform pale peach #ffd3b3 because real editable headings and body text will be laid over those areas. Keep a quiet flat peach margin around the illustration. No frame around the whole image, no mockup of a whole slide. The illustration itself can use small rounded rectangular concept-map panels with asymmetrical bento rhythms. Important objects comfortably inside the central 70% of the width for cropping.
Palette: dominant pale peach #ffd3b3, dark teal #183c43, turquoise #73d6e5, warm cream #f4f0e9, a little muted terracotta. Strong economical shapes, professional educational conference aesthetic.
Text: absolutely none. No letters, numbers, labels, logos, wordmarks, watermarks, equations, AI sparkles or humanoid robots.
Subject: a flat editorial vignette of classroom planning: an open lesson notebook connected to a small learning-path map made of unlabelled rounded panels, a pencil, and two small abstract profile silhouettes exchanging ideas. Emphasize responsible classroom practice and reflection. The compact composition sits in the upper-middle band with all of the bottom 45% empty peach.
